runs.notes: Glenn posted: "I've scheduled a special this Monday Nov 2 at 1:30 to the Pines if anyone wants to join let me know." On Nov 2 Glenn confirmed the run and moved it to 1:00 PM, Sayville to Pines. Peter Schwartz replied asking whether it is with Sayville Ferry, and said he might be interested in taking the return trip back. DJ Mike Borowski joined and confirmed he will be there.
runs.subject: [Pines Winter Ferry] Special to Pines / Monday Nov 2 @ 1:30 PM

runs.connection: Arrives Ocean Bay Park by 11:50 AM; riders sign up via the headcount form at fippoa.org/election-day-lateral-service
runs.notes: Election Day lateral water taxi service (not a Sayville run). Confirmed Nov 1 by Chris Mai (FIPPOA): a lateral special with SFS from the Pines to Ocean Bay Park for Election Day.
runs.riders_note: Sign-ups are collected through the FIPPOA headcount form, not by email, so rider names aren't listed here.
